adapter_profile_revisions_publication_st.name: adapter_profile_revisions_publication_state_time

health_no_session_observations_columns_m.name: health_no_session_observations_columns_match
health_no_session_observations_columns_m.value:
"health_no_session_observations"."observation"->>'providerId'="health_no_session_observations"."provider_id" AND "health_no_session_observations"."observation"->>'surfaceId'="health_no_session_observations"."observation_surface_id"
    AND "health_no_session_observations"."observation"->>'targetKey'="health_no_session_observations"."target_key" AND "health_no_session_observations"."observation"->>'strategyId'="health_no_session_observations"."strategy_id"
    AND ("health_no_session_observations"."observation"->>'strategyRevision')::integer="health_no_session_observations"."strategy_revision"
    AND "health_no_session_observations"."observation"->>'classification'="health_no_session_observations"."classification"
    AND "health_no_session_observations"."observation"->>'classificationBasis'="health_no_session_observations"."classification_basis"
    AND "health_no_session_observations"."observation"->>'surfaceOutcome'="health_no_session_observations"."surface_outcome"
    AND "health_no_session_observations"."observation"->>'blocker'="health_no_session_observations"."blocker"
    AND ("health_no_session_observations"."observation"->>'observedAt')::timestamptz="health_no_session_observations"."observed_at"
